paragraphs.text: Automatically archive idle DSH conversations after a configurable number of days and clear the expir
ed projection cache of archived sessions. Never deletes transcripts, attachments or workspace files.
# dsh-auto-archive
> A DSH plugin that automatically archives idle conversations and clears the expired projection cach
e of archived sessions — without deleting transcripts, attachments, workspace files or anything a co
nversation produced.
> 给 DeepSeek Harness（桌面版 / Web）用的本地插件：闲置会话按天自动归档，已归档会话的超期「对话缓存」自动清理，**不删除会话记录、附件或任何对话产出**。
## What it does / 它做什么
| Capability | Default | Behaviour |
| Auto-archive / 自动归档 | idle **14 days** | Calls DSH's official `workspaceRegistry.archiveSession()`

; archived sessions stay restorable from the archived list. |
| Cache cleanup / 缓存清理 | archived and
idle **90 days** (~3 months) | Deletes only DSH's derived projection cache (`~/.dsh/storages/session

_projcache/sessions/<id>.json`, rebuilt on demand). |
| Scheduled check / 巡检 | every **30 minutes**

| Silent background check; the settings panel can preview or run immediately. |
| Protection / 保护 |

pinned sessions | Optional extra allow-list by session id, workspace id or cwd fragment. |
| Audit /
审计 | last 30 runs | Per-run archive/cleanup details; restoring an archived session is one click. |
## Safety boundary / 安全边界
The plugin never deletes:

- session transcripts (`session.v4.jsonl.zstd` / session directories);
- attachments (`~/.dsh/attach

ments`), spill files, workspace or project files;
- results produced by a conversation — archiving o
nly adds/removes ids in DSH's archived set, and the content stays untouched.
Its only two writes are:
1. **Archive state** — adding/removing session ids in DSH's `archivedSessionIds` through the officia

l registry API (reversible).
2. **Projection cache** — deleting `~/.dsh/storages/session_projcache/s
essions/<id>.json`, a cache DSH rebuilds on demand.
Active sessions are always skipped (the plugin never passes `stopActivity`), so a running turn, job
or subagent is never interrupted.

## Configuration / 配置
Stored at `~/.dsh/auto-archive/config.json` (created automatically; editable from the panel):
[代码示例省略，未执行]
- `idleDays` — a session whose last activity is older than this is archived. Last activity = max(tra

nscript mtime, `createdAt`).
- `unusedDays` — an archived session idle longer than this has its proj

ection cache removed.
- `protect.workspaces` — workspace id or a case-insensitive cwd fragment; matc

hing workspaces are never archived.
- `dryRun: true` — every automatic run becomes a preview.
- `lim

its.maxOperationsPerRun` — caps one run, so a first launch cannot sweep the whole history at once.
-
Run state lives in `~/.dsh/auto-archive/state.json` (atomic writes, last 30 runs).
## HTTP API / 本机回环 API
Prefix `/dsh-auto-archive` (loopback Host only; anything else gets `403`):
| Method | Path | Purpose |

| GET | `/dsh-auto-archive/api/state` | Config, last/next run, counts |
| GET | `/dsh-auto-archive/a

pi/sessions?limit=200` | Session inventory with idle days and eligibility |
| GET | `/dsh-auto-archi

ve/api/history` | Last 30 runs |
| POST | `/dsh-auto-archive/api/config` | Deep-merge and save confi

g |
| POST | `/dsh-auto-archive/api/run` | `{"dryRun":true}` preview / `{"dryRun":false}` execute |
| POST | `/dsh-auto-archive/api/restore` | `{"sessionIds":["..."]}` unarchive |
## Development / 开发
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The host half interacts with DSH only through `ctx` services (`webServer`, `sessionPersistence`, `se
ssions`, `workspaceRegistry`, `sessionProjectionCache`); the client half is a hand-written `window._
_ModuleLoader__.load({...})` bundle with no build step. No third-party dependencies. Node ≥22.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Known limits / 已知限制

- Cache cleanup targets **archived** sessions only, so the active list is never touched.
- "Conversa
tion cache" means DSH's projection cache; transcripts and attachments are never deleted by design, s

o they keep their disk usage.
- Archiving obeys DSH's own activity check; a session another plugin c

onsiders active is skipped, never force-stopped.
- The host half loads at startup: restart DSH after

is skipped, never force-stopped.
- The host half loads at startup: restart DSH after changing code.
## Verified scope / 已验证范围
- **Settings panel** — opened in a real Edge (headless CDP) session at `bottom-left avatar → Setting
s → 自动归档`; panel renders status cards, config form, inventory and history with no console errors (se

e screenshot above).
- **Host API** — exercised on a scratch profile against real data: state/sessio
n inventory, dry-run (98 candidates → capped at 50), live archive of one session (`archivedSessionId

s` +1), restore, cache-cleanup candidate counting.
- **Safety** — only registry archive/unarchive ha
ppened against real data; the archive set was restored to its pre-test baseline, and no transcript,

attachment or workspace file was removed.
- **Tests** — 148 unit/client tests plus the fake-host e2e

r workspace file was removed.
